overall_goal: Toast ground black pepper in a frying pan

goals.description: Retrieve a spatula and open the black pepper jar
goals.rationale: The person gets a wooden spatula from the drawer to stir the pepper later, then picks up and struggles to open the black pepper jar.

goals.description: Grind black pepper into the frying pan
goals.rationale: The person repeatedly grinds peppercorns into the pan and shakes the jar to ensure all the ground pepper falls in.
